items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: when I heard an album called “Axis Bold as Love” that’s when I went and bought a fuzz tone and a wah-wah pedal

ctx.x: I consider Hendrix was like, he was the one rock & roll guitarist that I really listened to. I mean I didn’t really listen to a lot of the other guys. I mean I heard them, I liked some things, but when I heard him it was like listening to a jazz musician but playing a different kind of music. He played so fluid and liquid and just soulful and he was so creative that he could have been playing anything. It could have been any instrument. The vocabulary was not jazz like I know jazz, but it felt really improvised.…
really get the melody to it. It didn’t seem very melodic. And I thought Hendrix was very melodic.
